item.tib: dbal chen me phreng brgyad bskangs
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni rmongs btsun seng ge nyi ma la huM chen bla ma'i bka' 'bum bzhugs so mtshal kun smin byed dbang grol byed khrid/ rgyab brtan lung sogs bka' drin brtsal ba'i rjes su spyir bka' 'bum tshang ma dang bye brag stag lha rtsa gsum gyi cha lags (lag) ma tshang skor rnams kha bka' (bskang) dgos pa'i bka' yi gsang gsum ldog med gnang ba la btang snyoms 'jog par ma phod bris nongs pas bshags la legs srid dpon gsas bla ma dgyes pa'i mchod sprin du gyur cig/
